verdict.rationale: Mercury's own AI features inside the product are mostly automation: AI reads bills and auto-fills details, remembers past recipients, auto-attaches receipts, and offers AI-powered bookkeeping automations. Its explicitly insight-oriented features, the official agent skills (mercury-analyze-spend, mercury-detect-anomaly) and MCP natural-language queries like "Graph my last 6 months of transactions", run through external AI agents rather than inside the Mercury product. missing for 10: native in-dashboard AI insights or recommendations from account data, documentation of insight depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
